chapter: Where Waves Meet the Reef: Part I
act_title: The Top Dog of the Criminal Underworld

quests.title: The Top Dog of the Criminal Underworld

dialogue.t: The Flagship... Guess this participant decided to figure out lodging first.
Partner! Paimon!
Navia! It's been forever!
You got that right. Representing the Spina di Rosula, of course.
Top dog of the criminal underworld... Yep, that checks out.
Top dog of the criminal underworld... Yep, that checks out.
Haha, is that my new nickname? I'm not opposed — it's kinda snazzy.
It's great that we found you! We're working a commission to help with participant registration right now. Y'know, goods verification, stuff like that...
Oh, I see. Well, in that case, take a seat. I ordered a whole bunch of food. Clorinde and Chevreuse went to unpack some things, but should be back in a sec... Ohh, speak of the devil!
Talking about us?
Clorinde! Chevreuse! You're here too!
Nod-Krai is a chaotic and dangerous place. Considering the Spina's importance to Fontaine, the last thing we need is for something to happen to its president.
I do find it nice to travel with friends, but c'mon... Look who you're talking to! What's the worst that could happen?
With that nonchalant attitude, it's anybody's guess...
Fair enough. Guess you can mark down our Champion Duelist here as my... bodyguard.
Gang boss and her bodyguard... Got it. Should we mark you down for the expo too, Chevreuse?
No need. I'm here on official business. A lot of our recent cases have had ties to Nod-Krai.
Aaand that's Paimon's cue to butt out, hehe.
Oh, one more thing! What's the Spina planning to trade at the expo?
Ah, this right here! It's one of the Fontaine Research Institute's newest inventions. It's a kind of relay system that allows the user to unleash pneuma and ousia energy in battle!
So, it's... a weapon?
Of course! At a market with no legal oversight like this one, weapons are gonna be the first to go!
Guess so... Still, bragging about not having to follow the law in front of Chevreuse feels wrong.
I don't mind. I've read quite a bit about "lawless territories" in crime novels before.
As a detective, I know that I'll need to put the rules aside for now if I want to get things done here.
And, on that note, I should get to work. I've got Patrol members waiting on me.
Well, ready to head over to the venue? Just follow us!
Alright, let's get this show on the road! I wanna get a bit of shopping in as well.

dialogue.sit: You lead Navia and Clorinde to the venue.

dialogue.t: Wow, it's even bigger than I expected. I'm hoping more people will show up, though...
It'll get busier once things kick off. Still, looks like Jahoda needs a lot of help.
Well, Clorinde and I are all set up for now. Be sure to stop by our booth when you get a chance!

quests.description: Jahoda warns you that the individual staying at The Flagship is a top dog of the criminal underworld. You’d do well to stay on their good side…
